Where are they summoning those Molten from?!|audio = TakeoverMasterWave21.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 21 ([[The Takeover Event]], Master)}} }} ==Description== The '''Molten Summoner''' is a summoner enemy that appears in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a high amount of health, though it walks quite slowly. It has the [[Burn Immunity]], making it impossible to set on fire, and the [[Freeze Immunity]], making it impossible to freeze or chill. It has one ability, ''Hellish Summon'', where it summons three [[Elite Molten]]s with [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]]. ==Appearance== The '''Molten Summoner''' has red skin. Its head is entirely covered in light yellow bones, with a single eyehole showing a neon orange eye. It wears a few dark red bandages around its arms, a bone chestplate which also extends to its shoulder-pads. It wields a bone staff which contains an orange gem in it. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the the [[Turret]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Crook Boss]] can be useful here. **High DPS towers with splash damage capabilities can be especially useful, as they can hit both the '''Molten Summoner''' and the enemies it summons. Such towers include the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Engineer]]. *Area of effect towers like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]], [[Tesla]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful at dealing with the enemies spawned by the '''Molten Summoner'''. *No cash can be generated from summoned enemies. This includes the [[Cowboy]]'s cash generation. **However, this also means that the [[Cowboy]] will deal more DPS to the summons, as attacking summoned enemies does not make it spin its guns, making it attack for longer. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Summonr.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMoltenSummoner.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator Roblox Trailer|'''Molten Summoner''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Valentines Skins -
